name: XDS 喜德盛 AD500 2025
why_interesting: Current exact-2025 evidence resolves the consistent X6 aluminum and L-TWOO ER9 2x12 core while exposing real regional weight, fork and wheel differences. The dated mainland card still does not select one delivery BOM.
missing: Selected delivery-region BOM and corresponding complete-bike weight basis for the retained card
Controlled exact-model frame-stiffness magnitude and reproducible protocol
Current mainland seller, warranty, return route and final checkout conditions

facts.listing_identity: XDS / 喜德盛 AD500 2025 retained CNY 4,499 listing-image card
facts.complete_weight_references: Approximately 8.9 kg at 450 mm in Hong Kong, 9.23 kg without pedals in a mainland public report and 10.2 kg on the Vietnam regional page; retained delivery build unresolved
facts.drivetrain: L-TWOO ER9 electronic hydraulic 2x12 with 11-32T cassette and 50/34T Branta power-meter crank
facts.frame_material: X6 aluminum frame; exact current sources conflict between carbon and aluminum forks by market or batch
facts.fitted_tire: 700x28C on current exact builds; fitted size is not a manufacturer maximum
facts.frame_stiffness_status: No controlled exact-model stiffness magnitude or reproducible protocol found after 50 registered source areas

source_note: Current exact sources agree on the X6 aluminum and ER9 2x12 core but publish conflicting 8.9, 9.23 and 10.2 kg references plus carbon-versus-aluminum fork differences. No maximum clearance or controlled stiffness result is inferred.
